messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT P0 — Elevated p99 latency on /v1/generate — paging oncall
Alex: got the page, looking now. which cluster/region?
Mira: us-west2 inference pool A, noticed spike around 10:22 UTC
Devon: seeing p99 ~2.4s on the ingress side, p50/p95 ok. errors spiking to 1.8% 5xx
Alex: running quick probe: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}\n' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — local p99 ~2.3s
sre-bot: autoscaler event at 10:20: scale up started, 3 -> 6 pods, took ~45s
Jess: likely transient queueing on pods during scale. any OOMs or GPU throttles?
Samir: checking pod logs, one worker reported high KV cache evictions and long GC pause: `WARN kv_cache: eviction_count=423 latency_ms=120`\nno OOMs
Mira: customer impact: two paying customers reported timeouts for short windows — support created tickets INC-5821 and INC-5822
Devon: mitigation: forcing immediate extra burst capacity for region us-west2, increased desired to 9 pods, routing policy set to fallback model_small for non-SLAs
Alex: also muted the noisy p99 alert temporarily so it doesn't page while we stabilize (:lock: muted p99-generate-us-west2)
Jess: for post-incident we need an incident retro dashboard and tuned alerts:
Jess: proposed panels: p50/p95/p99 latencies (per-route), request rate, 5xx rate, pod start times, KV cache evictions, model GPU utilization, queue depth
Samir: suggested drilldowns: by model_name, by tenant_id, by region — make each panel link to a per-tenant timeseries
Mira: adding PromQL snippets for the dashboard panels:
Mira: latency p99 panel query:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, model_name, region))
```
Mira: 5xx rate:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..", route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (model_name, region)
```
Jess: queue depth (ingress queue length metric):
```
sum(ingress_queue_length{region="us-west2"}) by (model_name)
```
Alex: for alert tuning: propose change p99 alert threshold from 1.2s -> 1.8s for emergency pages, add a secondary anomaly alert for >50% relative increase in p99 over baseline
Devon: +1 to anomaly detection, it would reduce noise while catching sudden regressions
Jess: action items: Alex build the dashboard skeleton (panels above) + add drilldown links, Jess will write the new alert rule and PR the alert threshold changes, Samir will add KV cache eviction panel and annotate the incident, Mira to own the retro doc and link to the dashboard
Alex: ETA for dashboard MVP ~ 3h, I'll push a draft panel json to grafana-provisioning and ping for review
sre-bot: note: paging unmuted automatically at 11:05 if not manually reopened
Mira: logging this customer impact in incident ticket and scheduling 30m postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC
Samir: copying queries into the incident thread and will snapshot current dashboard for the retro
Alex: starting work now, will update thread with PR link
oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation applied — routing fallback and burst capacity added. monitor for regressions.
